name: Tuman'
source:
Mitya, a high school student, can't come to terms with the death of his younger brother. His world has collapsed, plunging into the silence of an empty house and the coldness of his relationship with his parents. His only salvation is friends, creativity, and his first love. But his pain gives birth to bizarre worlds: trains in the bedroom, talking clouds of light, and dreams that become more real than reality.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4002920/Mistbound/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
高中生米蒂亚无法接受弟弟的去世。他的世界崩溃了，陷入了空荡荡的房子里的寂静和与父母关系的冷漠。他唯一的救赎就是朋友、创造力和他的初恋。但他的痛苦催生了奇异的世界：卧室里的火车、会说话的光云，以及变得比现实更真实的梦想。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4002920/Mistbound/]Steam[/url]]
